header.running_head: The Ansaar Sacrifice worldly Pleasures and its Temporary possessions in Exchange for the Pleasure of Allaah and His Rasool ﷺ

blocks.text: The Ansaar Sacrifice worldly Pleasures and its Temporary possessions in Exchange for the Pleasure of Allaah and His Rasool ﷺ
The Story of The Ansaar when Makkah was Conquered

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Rabaah (RA) says, "Hadhrat Abu Hurayra (RA) and I were part of many delegations that came to Hadhrat Mu'aawiya (RA) during Ramadhaan. We used to prepare food for each other and Hadhrat Abu Hurayra (RA) very often invited us (to his camp[^1]) for meals. I once told myself that I should also invite everyone to my camp for meals. I therefore had meals prepared and when I met Hadhrat Abu Hurayra (RA) for the Isha salaah, I said to him, 'O Abu Hurayra (RA)! Meals will be served at my place tonight.' He commented, 'You have beat me to it.' 'I certainly have,' I replied. When the people were with me after I had called them, Hadhrat Abu Hurayra (RA) said, 'O gathering of Ansaar! Should I not inform you about an incident about your people?'"
Hadhrat Abu Hurayra (RA) then continued to relate the incident of the conquest of Makkah. He said that when Rasulullaah ﷺ entered Makkah, he appointed Hadhrat Zubayr (RA) to take charge of one of the flanks of the army. He then appointed Hadhrat Khaalid bin Waleed (RA) to take charge of the other flank of the army while Hadhrat Abu Ubaydah (RA) was put in charge of those Muslims who had no armour. As Rasulullaah ﷺ remained with his contingent, the rest marched through the centre of the valley. The Quraysh gathered the riffraff of their society and said, "We will send this lot forward (against the Muslims). If they achieve any success, we shall join them. If they are defeated, we shall have to give in to the demands of Rasulullaah ﷺ."
Hadhrat Abu Hurayra (RA) narrates further that when Rasulullaah ﷺ lifted his gazes, he saw him and called for him. Hadhrat Abu Hurayra (RA) replied, "I am at your service, O Rasulullaah ﷺ!" Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "Call the Ansaar for me and ensure that none but them come." Hadhrat Abu Hurayra (RA) called for them and they arrived. When they had gathered around Rasulullaah ﷺ, he said to them, "Do you see the riffraff of the Quraysh and those with them?" Passing his one hand over the other, Rasulullaah ﷺ then said, "Mow them down and then meet me at Safa." Hadhrat Abu Hurayra (RA) says, "We then proceeded. We were in a position of killing as many of the Quraysh as we pleased, while none of them were in a position to offer any resistance."
Hadhrat Abu Sufyaan (RA) then said, "O Rasulullaah ﷺ! You have permitted the extermination of all the Quraysh. There shall be none of the Quraysh left after today."
